The seven instruments

InstrumentAcronymMeasuresMassStatus

Cosmic Dust AnalyserCDA-2Grain size, charge, impact rate17 kgFlight ready

Cassini legacy data

What's in the spray

Relative abundance of materials Cassini detected in the Enceladus plume and Saturn's E-ring — the baseline AETHELON will measure in far greater detail.

91%Water ice
4%CO₂
3.2%CH₄ + N₂
1.4%Organics
0.5%Silica
0.3%NaCl salts

The people

Science team

RV

Dr. Renata Vasquez

Principal Investigator

Planetary chemist; led Cassini's last plume flythrough. Builds AETHELON's case for slow, low-altitude sampling.

KO

Dr. Kenji Ono

Mass Spectrometry Lead

Designed SUNA's impact-ionisation source to keep fragile organics intact at flythrough speeds.

AB

Dr. Amara Boateng

Mission Navigator

Plots the four-planet gravity-assist chain and threads each flyby to within a kilometre of target.

LM

Dr. Lucas Meyer

Ice & Radar Science

Models the shell's tidal flexing and interprets REASON-E sounding to find the ocean's roof.

SP

Dr. Saanvi Patel

Astrobiology Lead

Sets the biosignature thresholds — what molecular pattern would count as evidence of life.

TG

Dr. Tomás García

Spacecraft Systems

Owns power, thermal and autonomy — keeping a sterilised probe alive for 20 years in the cold.
